n1.speaker: okafor
n1.text: Come in and take a seat. What seems to be the problem today?

branches.suggestion: I've been getting headaches for about two weeks.
My back has been hurting since I moved a sofa.
branches.suggestionFa: از وقتی یه مبل جابه‌جا کردم کمرم درد می‌کنه.

newWords.word: what seems to be the problem

n2.speaker: okafor
n2.text: I see. Is the pain worse at a particular time of day?

translations.fa: متوجهم. درد تو زمان خاصی از روز بدتره؟

branches.suggestion: It's usually worse in the evening, after work.
branches.suggestionFa: معمولاً عصرها، بعد از کار، بدتره.

branches.suggestion: It's worst first thing in the morning.

n3.speaker: okafor
n3.text: And how many hours a day do you spend looking at a screen?

translations.fa: و روزی چند ساعت به صفحه‌نمایش نگاه می‌کنید؟

branches.suggestion: Probably eight or nine, to be honest.
Not many. I work outside mostly.
branches.suggestionFa: زیاد نه. بیشتر بیرون کار می‌کنم.

n4.speaker: okafor
n4.text: That could be it. If you take regular breaks, the headaches will probably improve. If they don't, we'll do some tests.

translations.fa: ممکنه همین باشه. اگه مرتب استراحت کنید، سردردها احتمالاً بهتر میشن. اگه نشدن، چندتا آزمایش می‌گیریم.

branches.suggestion: What will happen if I keep getting them?
branches.suggestionFa: اگه همچنان ادامه پیدا کنه چی میشه؟

branches.suggestion: Should I get my eyes tested too?

n5.speaker: okafor
n5.text: Good idea. An optician can test your eyes for about twenty pounds. If you need glasses, that'll make a big difference.

translations.fa: فکر خوبیه. بینایی‌سنج با حدود بیست پوند چشمتون را معاینه می‌کنه. اگه عینک لازم باشه، خیلی فرق می‌کنه.

branches.suggestion: I'll book an eye test this week.
branches.suggestionFa: این هفته وقت معاینهٔ چشم می‌گیرم.

cultureNote.en: In the UK you go to an optician (on the high street) for eye tests, not to your GP.
cultureNote.fa: برای معاینهٔ چشم به optician بروید.

n6.speaker: okafor
n6.text: An eye specialist on the high street. Come back in a month if you're not feeling better, and drink more water!

translations.fa: یه متخصص چشم تو خیابون اصلی. اگه حالتون بهتر نشد یه ماه دیگه برگردید، و بیشتر آب بخورید!
